items.title: In Other News: Tanker Cyberattacks, EU Quantum Act, New VirusTotal Capabilities
items.description: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: RansomwareHelp accused of profiting from ransom payments, USDA payment systems breach, cybersecurity firm Radware hacked. The post In Other News: Tanker Cyberattacks, EU Quantum Act, New VirusTotal Capabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: 100,000 Potentially Impacted by Colorado Data Breach
items.description: Hackers breached the digital identification and document storage application myColorado and accessed user-uploaded data. The post 100,000 Potentially Impacted by Colorado Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Hex Package Manager Warns of Potential Data Breach
items.description: A vulnerability in hex.pm allowed hackers to run commands on web servers. No evidence of data modification was found, but database reads are not logged. The post Hex Package Manager Warns of Potential Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: SAP Confirms Cyberattack, Source Code Reportedly Compromised
items.description: SAP has detected suspicious activity on GitHub, where hackers reportedly used stolen employee tokens to copy and alter source code. The post SAP Confirms Cyberattack, Source Code Reportedly Compromised appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: FIFA Says It Has Been Victim of a Cyberattack Accessing ‘Personal and Business Information’
items.description: FIFA didn’t say when the cyberattack took place, or the precise nature of the hacked information. The post FIFA Says It Has Been Victim of a Cyberattack Accessing ‘Personal and Business Information’ appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Critical Juniper Session Smart Conductor Flaw Exploited in Attacks
items.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-103406, the vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root. The post Critical Juniper Session Smart Conductor Flaw Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days Exploited in Suspected AI-Assisted Attacks
items.description: Accenture says hackers exploited MiCollab flaws before Mitel’s advisory, likely aided by AI, in a suspected extortion campaign. The post Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days Exploited in Suspected AI-Assisted Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Drupal Installer Patch Left a Gap Attackers Are Already Exploiting
items.description: Drupal warns that its previous installer patch left some websites vulnerable to takeover, with attackers already exploiting the gap. The post Drupal Installer Patch Left a Gap Attackers Are Already Exploiting appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: 1Password Breach Exposes Customer Data, Internal Source Code
items.description: A hacker used a compromised employee GitHub account to push malicious code and steal customer records, but vaults were not accessed. The post 1Password Breach Exposes Customer Data, Internal Source Code appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack
items.description: Attackers are probing GeoServer instances for two high-severity flaws that can be chained with other bugs for unauthenticated RCE. The post Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack appeared first on SecurityWeek .
